Title: Azure Data Explorer extends geospatial functionality

Body.Content:
Azure Data Explorer supports geospatial functions since 2019.

The following functions support geospatial clustering based on a sphere surface and have been added recently:

  • geo_point_to_s2cell() (Calculates the S2 cell token string value for a geographic location)
  • geo_s2cell_to_central_point() (Calculates the geospatial coordinates that represent the center of S2 Cell)

Additionally, it's now possible to render map data using pie charts and scatterplots in KustoExplorer.
